;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Terrorism in the United States]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Missouri]]
**[[Federal Bureau of Investigation|FBI]] agents shoot dead an armed man during an arrest operation in [[Belton, Missouri]], U.S. The man was suspected of plotting a [[bombing]] attack, with [[American far-right|far-right]] motivations, at a [[Kansas City, Missouri|Kansas City]] hospital believed to be treating [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] patients. [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/domestic-terrorist-allegedly-plotted-car-bomb-hospital-coronavirus/story?id=69803480 (ABC News)] [https://www.cnn.com/2020/03/25/us/missouri-man-killed-fbi-investigation/index.html (CNN)]

;Arts and culture
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
**The [[Badaling]] section of the [[Great Wall of China]] reopens to visitors. [https://www.cnn.com/travel/article/badaling-great-wall-china-reopens-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on the 2020 Summer Olympics]]
**After the [[2020 Summer Olympics|Summer Olympics]] is postponed, the [[Tokyo]] station's Olympic countdown clock displaying the number of days until the Games (a local tourist attraction) is switched to show the current date and time. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2020/03/25/national/olympic-clock/#.Xns9c9ThDeg (''The Japan Times'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Mozambique people smuggling disaster]]
**64 [[People of Ethiopia|Ethiopian]] [[illegal immigrant]]s are found dead and 14 alive inside a [[cargo container]] on a lorry in [[Tete Province]], [[Mozambique]], apparently having died of [[asphyxiation]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/03/60-people-dead-cargo-container-mozambique-200324104510678.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
****[[Premier of the People's Republic of China|Premier]] [[Li Keqiang]] says that the spread of the epidemic has been basically blocked and the outbreak controlled within China. [http://english.scio.gov.cn/m/topnews/2020-03/24/content_75852078.htm (State Council Information Office)]
****[[2020 Hubei lockdowns]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Hubei]]
*****[[China]] is expected to end lockdowns on most of the [[Hubei]] province. [[Wuhan]], the epicenter of the coronavirus, is expected to reopen on April 8. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/china-lift-lockdown-virus-hit-hubei-province-69763100 (ABC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]], [[Indian local government response to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
****Complete [[2020 India coronavirus lockdown|lockdown]]s are announced in 30 [[States and union territories of India|states and union territories]] of [[India]] in an effort to stop the spread of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/articleshow/74783719.cms (''The Times of India'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Nepal]]
****[[Nepal]] enters in a total and nationwide lockdown for a week. [https://kathmandupost.com/national/2020/03/23/nepal-goes-under-lockdown-for-a-week-starting-6am-tuesday (''Kathmandu Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Saudi Arabia]]
****[[Saudi Arabia]] reports the country's first death from COVID-19, as the total number of cases rises to 767. The patient was an [[Afghans|Afghan]] expatriate. [https://gulfnews.com/world/gulf/saudi/coronavirus-saudi-arabia-reports-first-death-205-new-cases-of-covid-19-1.1585054457152 (''Gulf News'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand]]
****[[New Zealand]] reports 40 new cases of coronavirus. [https://www.stuff.co.nz/national/health/coronavirus/120517335/coronavirus-latest-cases-to-be-confirmed-at-1pm-press-conference (Stuff NZ)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
**** [[Australia]] announces a nationwide lockdown, outlawing all travel interstate and overseas, and closing the nation's borders. Schools remain open in some locations. [https://www.news.com.au/lifestyle/health/health-problems/coronavirus-australia-live-updates/live-coverage/61905509d50066aa5258863f99847d52 (News.com.au)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****[[Spain]]'s [[Ministry of Health (Spain)|Ministry of Health]] reports 514 more deaths from COVID-19, the highest daily death toll in the country to date. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-52020060 (BBC News)]
****The Palacio de Hielo [[ice rink]] in [[Madrid]] begins to be used as a [[morgue]] as the city's funeral homes are not able to hold all COVID-19 victims. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/03/24/europe/spain-ice-rink-morgue-coronavirus-intl/index.html (CNN)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[Cameroon]]ian musician and songwriter [[Manu Dibango]] dies from COVID-19 in [[Paris]], France. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-52017834 (BBC News)]
****France reports 2,444 new confirmed cases of COVID-19 and 240 more deaths, bringing the country's total to 22,300 cases and over 1000 deaths. [https://www.france24.com/en/20200324-france-s-scientific-council-says-coronavirus-lockdown-should-last-at-least-six-weeks (France 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
****The [[Government of Poland|government]] introduces new measures over the ongoing coronavirus pandemic in the country: a ban on gatherings of more than two people, from the current 50. However, the number of people allowed to take part in religious services, including funerals, is limited to five. The new restrictions are to last until at least 11 April. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-poland/poland-further-limits-movement-over-coronavirus-sticks-to-election-date-idUSKBN21B24J (BBC News)]
****[[Prime Minister of Poland|Prime Minister]] [[Mateusz Morawiecki]] tells at a news conference on Tuesday that the [[2020 Polish presidential election|presidential election]], scheduled for 10 May, will not be affected by the coronavirus pandemic and will go ahead as planned. [https://tvn24.pl/tvn24-news-in-english/poland-reports-152-coronavirus-cases-on-tuesday-the-most-on-one-day-so-far-4513393 (TVN24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Vatican City]]
****[[Roman Curia]] confirms three more cases, raising to four. [https://www.ilmessaggero.it/vaticano/coronavirus_vaticano_papa_francesco_casi_contagi_curia_comunicato_uffici_amuchina-5130705.html (''Il Messaggero'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Chile]]
****Despite a week-long lockdown, [[Easter Island|Easter Island (Rapa Nui)]] reports its first case of coronavirus. [https://www.cnnchile.com/coronavirus/de-origen-autoctono-rapa-nui-confirma-primer-contagio-de-coronavirus-en-la-isla_20200324/ (CNN Chile)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Africa]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Egypt]]
****[[Egypt]] declares a two-week nationwide [[curfew]] between 7pm and 6am to prevent the spread of the virus. Those who break the curfew will be fined up to 4,000 [[Egyptian pound|pound]]s or be jailed, according to [[Prime Minister of Egypt|Prime Minister]] [[Mostafa Madbouly]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-egypt/egypt-declares-two-week-curfew-to-counter-coronavirus-idUSKBN21B1MR (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Libya]]
****The [[National Centre for Disease Control]] reports [[Libya]]'s first confirmed case of COVID-19, a patient at a hospital in [[Tripoli, Libya|Tripoli]]. The [[World Health Organization]] has warned that the virus could cause Libya's already struggling health system to collapse. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-libya-measures/libya-confirms-first-coronavirus-case-amid-fear-over-readiness-idUKKBN21B2SF (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in California]]
*****The number of confirmed cases of COVID-19 in [[California]] reaches 2,226, with 42 deaths. [https://www.latimes.com/projects/california-coronavirus-cases-tracking-outbreak/#nt=1PromoSuperLeadLarge-1col-7030col1-mainnt=1PromoSuperLeadLarge-1col-7030col1-main (''Los Angeles Times'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)|COVID-19 pandemic in New York]]
*****[[Vice President of the United States|U.S. Vice President]] [[Mike Pence]] says [[Federal Emergency Management Agency|FEMA]] will send 4,000 [[ventilator]]s to [[New York (state)|New York]] in the next 48 hours. The state now has at least 20,000 confirmed cases of COVID-19. [https://www.washingtonexaminer.com/news/pence-announces-federal-government-shipping-4k-ventilators-to-new-york (''Washington Examiner'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]]
*****[[List of mayors of Detroit|Detroit Mayor]] [[Mike Duggan]] confirms nine members of the [[Detroit Police Department]] have tested positive for COVID-19, with one death, a 38-year-old male dispatcher. An additional 233 officers have been quarantined since Sunday. [https://www.mlive.com/public-interest/2020/03/nine-members-of-detroit-police-department-test-positive-for-coronavirus-one-dead.html (MLive.com)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Florida]]
*****[[Playwright]] [[Terrence McNally]] dies from complications of COVID-19 in [[Florida]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-52029391 (BBC News)]
*A man in the [[China|Chinese]] [[provinces of China|province]] of [[Yunnan]] dies after testing positive for [[hantavirus]]. [https://www.newsweek.com/what-hantavirus-man-china-tests-positive-after-dying-infection-spread-rodents-1493924 (''Newsweek'')]

**[[China]] launches three [[People's Liberation Army|military]] [[Reconnaissance satellite|surveillance satellites]] on a [[Long March 2C]] rocket. [https://www.space.com/china-long-march-2c-yaogan-satellites-launch-success.html (Space.com)]

;Sports

**The [[2020 Summer Olympics]] has been postponed for the first time in the modern Olympic Games history to 2021 in response to the [[COVID-19]] pandemic. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2020/mar/24/tokyo-olympics-to-be-postponed-to-2021-due-to-coronavirus-pandemic (''The Guardian'')]
